answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the pigment of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the wharf re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the jetty of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
